summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries. Support for preserving E-Rate funding and infrastructure for educational access.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase operational costs for school districts
claims.evidence_quote: If E-Rate funding ceases, we would have to divert funds from other critical needs to ensure our teaching and learning and many other network dependent operations continue.

filer_raw: Dr. Matthew J. Link - Northern Lehigh School District
